slot_scores.name: product_I_no_production_Q2
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether any product has quarter-specific production restrictions, nor specifically whether Product I can be produced in Q2. Questions about capacity (turn 9), per-quarter quantity limits (turn 12), storage (turn 14), and other constraints (turn 15) do not target the Product I / Q2 restriction.

slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the contract reservation figures in Table 1-10 minimum delivery requirements that must be met each quarter, or are they target values that can be exceeded or missed (with the delay compensation covering any shortfall)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed the demand fulfillment semantics, and turn 5 further clarified whether unmet reservations become backlog to be fulfilled later or are simply lost, covering the requirement and late-delivery handling.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: That there are no quarter-specific production restrictions, i.e., Product I can be produced in every quarter including Q2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about quarter-specific production restrictions for any product, yet in READY_TO_MODEL it asserted 'No other constraints' with no mention of a Product I Q2 restriction, implicitly assuming all products are producible in all quarters.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 slot H1 (Product I cannot be produced in Q2) remained entirely unasked and unconfirmed, treating all quarters as equally available for production.

summary: The agent clarified the demand/delay semantics well (H2), but never probed quarter-specific production restrictions (H1) and stopped with that P1 slot unresolved, silently assuming Product I could be produced in Q2.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
